cells.gaps: No decision, sanction or count under the Digital Code is reported, so application stops at activity. The authority the Code provides (COD-012) is not installed; the ARPTC has exercised its missions provisionally since the ministerial order of 17 August 2024 (COD-019, COD-016).
cells.note: The Digital Code is in force and the ARPTC's decision on prior formalities was published in the Journal officiel on 23 April 2026 (COD-017), but application is only activity, so stage 4 is not met. The ARPTC is acting as the authority, so no cap is engaged.
